1.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
1.asv: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

2.web: Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
2.asv: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

3.web: and tell it, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
3.asv: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.

4.web: I will lay your cities waste, and you shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
4.asv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

5.web: Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;
5.asv: Because thou hast had a perpetual enmity, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;

6.web: therefore, as I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will prepare you for blood, and blood shall pursue you: since you have not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue you.
6.asv: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.

7.web: Thus will I make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
7.asv: Thus will I make mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.

8.web: I will fill its mountains with its slain: in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses shall they fall who are slain with the sword.
8.asv: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

9.web: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities shall not be inhabited; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
9.asv: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

10.web: Because you have said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Yahweh was there:
10.asv: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Jehovah was there:

11.web: therefore, as I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge you.
11.asv: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast showed out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.

12.web: You shall know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they have been given us to devour.
12.asv: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.

13.web: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.
13.asv: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.

14.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
14.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

15.web: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do to you: you shall be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
15.asv: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
